---
title: v2.5.0 — Unified Work and Tooling CLI Contracts
---

## Overview

This release introduces a shared registry for the public Work and Tooling CLI contracts. Both CLIs provide on-demand contract listing, descriptions, scaffolds, and examples while retaining their existing response envelopes and domain validation.

## Highlights

- Generate command and contract indexes from the shared registry, with build-time checks for references and resource integrity.
- Add focused contract queries and a Contract Skill that locates the installed Work and Tooling CLIs.
- Package and install the Contract Skill alongside Work and Tooling, with release and installer checks.
